# Geometry Wars 2 PC Plus 1.1.1

This is an unofficial fan-made port, not affiliated with or endorsed by the game's makers or publishers, and **no game files are included**: you need your own Xbox Live Arcade package.

## Fixed

- **Watch Replay on the game's leaderboard screen now plays the board you're looking at.** It used to open the player's Deadline replay whichever board was showing. Now Evolved plays their Evolved run, King their King run, and so on, Master boards included. Watch replays was never affected.

## Installing

1. Download **GeometryWarsRetroEvolved2-v1.1.1-windows-x64.zip**, extract it anywhere you can write to, and run `geometry_wars_retro_evolved_2.exe`. Updating: extract over your current folder, or use the launcher's update.
2. On the **Play** page click **Install from package...** and pick your Geometry Wars: Retro Evolved 2 package (Title ID `584108FF`, game version 0.0.1.2).
3. Press **PLAY**.

Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit), a DirectX 12 graphics card and the latest Microsoft Visual C++ 2015-2022 Redistributable (x64) are needed. The build is not digitally signed, so SmartScreen may warn: choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
